claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Prednisolone at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a direct cytotoxic agent; glucocorticoid receptor agonism produces growth arrest and apoptosis only in lymphoid-lineage lines at higher concentrations and over longer exposures, so no broad or selective killing pattern is expected in a 5-day pooled screen.
